checks.claim_group: All rejected roots abort before repository open; mixed roots can write before incomplete-source error
checks.conditions_and_limits: All-invalid means every target rejected by Lstat in the ordinary filesystem-target path. Metadata accessibility is not content readability. Mixed output requires other gates and Snapshot to succeed; dry-run/skip-if-unchanged or fatal archiver errors need not emit a new snapshot. Final uses can, not must.

checks.claim_group: Regression test is helper-level and not a repository-write/Windows quote reproduction
checks.conditions_and_limits: Existing directory plus file/child and embedded NUL inputs; assertions call filterExisting directly. No upstream or local test was executed by reviewer.

checks.claim_group: Default structural checking is separate from full or subset pack reads
checks.conditions_and_limits: Default Structure checks tree/reference/index availability; data reading is conditional on flags. Pack checks establish engine consistency, not PM importability.

checks.claim_group: Data verification can be bound to selected snapshot or repository scope
checks.conditions_and_limits: Selected snapshots determine referenced blobs and encompassing packs. Shared packs and repository-wide index/pack structure checks can exceed one snapshot; exact scope/cost still needs PM admission/adapter conformance. Final does not claim such integration ran.

checks.claim_group: Partition receipts need fixed inventory identity for a complete-coverage claim
checks.conditions_and_limits: Bucket assignment uses pack-ID byte modulo t. All partitions and matching selection/inventory must be accounted for. New/repacked data can invalidate an old complete-inventory claim. Inventory digest/invalidation is a proposed PM control, not native Restic receipt evidence.

checks.claim_group: Percentage/size selectors cannot guarantee complete coverage
checks.conditions_and_limits: Proper random subsets have no deterministic eventual coverage guarantee. At 100 percent every pack is selected; size at/above inventory size is capped to full size, and a one-pack inventory can be fully selected by a small positive percentage. This exception limits the blanket wording. The proposed --read-data full-data path remains valid; no false recovery pass results.

checks.claim_group: Restic copy is a cross-repository option with read/upload and deduplication costs
checks.conditions_and_limits: Independent destination identity remains necessary. Different encryption keys require transfer; matching chunker parameters avoid the documented deduplication loss. Same-backend configuration can apply to both repositories, so distinct-account behavior is not guaranteed by this documentation. Default proposal uses separate uploads instead.

checks.claim_group: Kopia offers structural/blob checks versus downloaded/decrypted/decompressed file verification
checks.conditions_and_limits: Documentation-level alternative, not examined Kopia code or proof of equivalent PM behavior. Neither engine validity nor documentation claims establish application recovery. Final does not select Kopia.
